title: Expected detection result of an import test file
description: What automatic detection (docs/spec.md 10.1) must find in one file in tests/import. The settings use the words of the load options in spec/commands.json. bom is not an option, because a byte order mark is always skipped.

doc.description: What the file tests, in one sentence.

encoding.description: As the encoding option of load.

bom.description: The file starts with a byte order mark.

sep.description: As the sep option of load.

decimal.description: As the decimal option of load.

skip.description: As the skip option of load: the number of metadata lines before the table, including blank lines. Comment lines are not counted.

comment.description: The text that starts comment lines, or null if there are none.

header.description: As the header option of load: 0 (none), 1 (column labels), or 2 (column labels, then units).

label.description: The text of the column in the header row, or null without a header row.

unit.description: The text of the column in the unit row, or null without a unit row.

missing.description: The number of missing values (NaN) in the column.
